items.description: Appoint a CO fluent in AML and submit their PHDF, together with relevant enclosures, as well as a Letter of engagement and CV . No SOW required

items.title: Financial Statements
items.description: Submit FS for year ending 2023 and signed financials in whatever form which are not older than 6 months

items.title: Business Plan
items.description: The Business Plan lacks information and criteria listed in the guidelines on the application portal. It does not include a detailed management structure showing allocated responsibilities and controls. Detailed Information on the business rationale, payment gateways, contractual and financial model with key suppliers, together with a detailed 3 year financial forecasts showing a break down of marketing expenses, any loans, commissions and other necessary figures is required. Revise business plan guidelines and resubmit business plan

items.description: 1. Submit a director's declaration confirming the relationship between the applicant company and the SOF bank statement submitted in the name of V5 N.V 2. Resubmit the said bank statement duly certified. 3. Provide an update certified statement showing funds owned by the company through cashflow or other means, which is not older than 6 months 4. Submit a director's declaration as above with regards to the transaction screen shot and resubmit duly certified
